author: CocoNeedsHelp
text_post: Personally, i wear quite a moderate-heavy amount of make-up, though if someone asks me, i would tell them the truth. I'd apply a full face of foundation (to cover the scars i have on my face due to Folliculitis/hyper-pigmentation). I'd then do my eyebrows, contour my nose and put some lip gloss on. I'd then put some eyeliner on, to try and "hide" my awfully downturned eyes. When it comes to the face, i'd say i'm a solid 2/10, not pleasant to look at xD  My intentions when putting on makeup are not harmful or anything. I simply put it on because i'm way too insecure, and i don't want to be a burden on society's eyes.  Thing is, with makeup on, i wouldn't exceed a 4/10. I put on makeup with the sole purpose of looking "normal" rather than morphing into some artificial version of myself. oh well
